description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). Replaces ln_pre and ln_post (pre-LUT norms) with minimal CenterScale = (x - per_token_mean) * gamma, where gamma is ONE global learnable scalar (init 1.0). No std-division, no per-channel affine. NB: for a sign-based LUT this is a near-no-op on SELECTION (mean-sub and a single positive scalar are both sign-preserving) -> it only rescales |d| magnitude (absorbed by learnable T). So this is effectively an ABLATION of LayerNorm's per-channel affine (gamma,beta) on ln_pre/ln_post: if exp470 ~= exp453, the affine was not load-bearing and the norm can be this minimal; if worse, it was. q_norm/k_norm/ln_final stay LayerNorm. Saves checkpoint.
